notes.title: Patch 0d.2.1 - Minor improvements and bug fixes.
notes.content:
Hello, survivalists! 
 I had to urgently publish a small patch with new features and bug fixes. 
 New features: 
 The models of people have been redesigned according to their factions. Now it will be much easier to distinguish between them and be wary of those who are hostile to you.

 The reputation panel now allows you to inspect the appearance of a particular faction. This will make it easier to remember who belongs to which faction and will help you progress through the story more quickly.

The settings menu has been added to the gameplay itself.
Bug fixes:
Translations for the radio station console have been added

Markers and hints have been added to some parts of the interface

The lighting and color scheme have been fixed.

 The strange behavior of enemy creatures has been fixed.

 The game's difficulty has been improved.

Fixed mouse sensitivity

notes.title: Survival City DEMO 0d.2.0 patch
notes.content:
A new long-awaited patch has become available in Survival City DEMO, which completely changes the perception of the game. The world map has been completely redesigned, the plot has been edited and much more! See the patch details below.
List of changes: 
We saw the problem of the empty world perfectly well, and we promptly set about fixing it. The voids in the streets were fixed and the interior inside the buildings was completely redesigned. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45448675/7a6864b69d14e60fcae4e7457917c1643f71e53f.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45448675/122e62e267f3ea54c78378ca6d2b8dcde5988335.png"]

Some mechanics have been added to make it easier to navigate the storyline and navigate the terrain in general:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45448675/652158057f8f3d390b5818a181135f449b9421f5.png"]

The main interface has been redesigned

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45448675/ba09f6ac95372183004cd12bf08456195e89df1b.png"]

Also, at the request of many, we added training (we should have done this before XD)

The player's dash mechanic has become a basic ability, now it will be easier to dodge bullets and biting enemies.

The English localization has been redesigned, now it looks better. 

Added... Stairs! Now you can climb higher in some places. A lighthouse, for example.

A new enemy: Zombies. He was once an ordinary citizen, but now he's just a dead man walking. It looks harmless. 

Fixed the behavior of all creatures

A number of optimizations have been performed

People can now kick a player if he stands too close in aggressive mode.
Future plans:
We will no longer update the DEMO version of the game, and we will be preparing to create the full version. There will be new quests, a lot of plot, riddles, new items, bosses, and a lot more!

Add it to your wish list!

Your EngieDEV.
